style: real top-down studio photograph, warm natural colour, plain white background
themeWhy: the same desk of wooden rod and ruler, ribbon and road as Measure It: kraft-paper keys in a tan family with a magenta-marker Enter as the treat, soft cream keys and a very light panel; no red, no violet.

images.object: plain light beechwood metre rod, blank face
images.why: Description 'Break a metre rod into centimetres' and Student controls 'Metre rod: breaks one metre at a time into a hundred centimetre marks': the rod's wooden body, one long straight flat bar 18:1 (the 900 by 50 metre rod across the top, each metre that breaks, the metre rods the marks gather into, the small rod that hops into the metres column); the 100 centimetre marks are drawn in code over it.
images.prompt: A plain, smooth, natural light beechwood measuring rod lying flat, perfectly straight and horizontal, with fine straight wood grain running along its length and a soft satin varnish; the face is completely blank and unmarked.

images.object: blank pale beechwood school ruler, plain face
images.why: Look 'a metre rod in ten tens' and phase 2 'a row of centimetre marks': the ruler's wooden body under the row of centimetre marks a length in centimetres is read on; the marks and numbers are drawn in code over it.
images.prompt: A flat, thin school ruler made of pale cream-coloured beechwood, lying perfectly straight and horizontal, with a smooth satin finish, squared ends and one bevelled long edge; the face is completely plain and unmarked.

images.object: crimson satin ribbon, both ends straight and square
images.why: Description 'add and subtract lengths in columns' and Student controls 'Column board' lengths in metres and centimetres: one length of ribbon laid straight and horizontal beside the given length it stands for, stretched to the length (a straight square end each side).
images.prompt: A single length of rich crimson satin ribbon lying perfectly straight and horizontal and completely flat, a smooth glossy sheen along its length, with a clean flat straight end at the left and a clean flat straight end at the right, both ends square to the long edges and neat.

images.object: straight stretch of dark asphalt road, top-down
images.why: Description 'slide kilometre posts along a road' and Student controls 'Kilometre road: slides a post along the road a thousand metres at a time': one straight stretch of road for each kilometre section of the 980 long road under the rod, drawn once per kilometre; the posts, markers and labels are drawn in code.
images.prompt: A single straight stretch of freshly laid, very dark charcoal asphalt road lying horizontally across the picture, a fine stony surface, a dashed white centre stripe along its middle and a narrow pale concrete kerb along each long side.
